criteria.criterion:
`vloop fence check --phase verify --root --tool [--path

] [""]` gives every decision of the brief's two worked-example tables and its two apply_patch lines, with exactly the reasons shown there (`deny: ` followed by the message), exit 0 for allow and 1 for deny.
criteria.evidence: internal/fence/judge_test.go TestVerifyPhase asserts every row of both tables and both apply_patch lines with exact reason strings; the go check log is green. Exit codes are the unchanged check command path.

criteria.criterion: In verify a call is decided exactly as in review, with three differences only: shell denials by a fence rule read `<command> is denied by the verify fence (Bash(<rule>))`; write and tool denials name the phase `verify` (`write to <path> is not allowed in a verify session: only .vloop/tmp/ may be written`, `tool <name> is not allowed in a verify session`); the skill hint is `skill <name> is not vloop's — use /vloop:verify`. Deny-list denials keep `<command> is denied by the Copilot deny list (<stem>)` with `rm:*` included. The rules are read from the embedded `fence/verify.json` (not from `fence/review.json`, and not from a second hand-copied list).
criteria.evidence: judge.go New reads vloop.Fence(phase) for verify; fenceLabel and skillPhase return verify; everything else is shared with review. TestVerifyPhase pins the messages, including rm:* via the deny list.

criteria.criterion:
An unknown phase (`plan`, `gate-review`, anything else) exits 2 with `vloop: unknown phase "

": want review, second-review, work or verify` on stderr.
criteria.evidence: judge.go:54 new message; TestUnknownPhase asserts it for plan; the CLI path wraps New's error as before and the cli tests pass in the go check.

criteria.criterion: `vloop fence check --help` and `vloop fence hook --help` name `verify` among the phases in their usage line, their `--phase` flag and their long help; `docs/guide/commands.md` is regenerated with `go generate ./...` in this task, so `TestCommandsReferenceIsCurrent` stays green in the `go` check.
criteria.evidence: internal/cli/fence.go updates Use, Long and the --phase flag text for both commands; docs/guide/commands.md carries the matching changes; the go check is green.

criteria.criterion: The review, second-review and work phases decide and word every call exactly as before (the unchanged lines: `--phase review --tool skill --path vloop-verify` is `deny: skill vloop-verify is not vloop's — use /vloop:review`; `--phase work` allows `rm src/old.go`; `vloop config set agent.gate-review copilot` exits 2 with `vloop: invalid value "copilot" for agent.gate-review: want one of claude`). Existing tests that pin `verify` as an unknown phase or the old unknown-phase message change only to the new behaviour, and the work notes name the contract item (V1).
criteria.evidence: The diff only adds verify branches in judge.go; review and work fall through the same paths. The only changed earlier test is TestUnknownPhase, which now pins the new message, and its comment cites V1. The existing review and work tests still pass in the go check.

criteria.criterion: The verify phase is covered by committed Go table tests in `internal/fence` that run on every OS in the `go` check, covering every line of the worked example's two tables, the apply_patch lines and the unknown-phase message; a verify phase with no committed tests is a violation.
`fence/verify.json`, `fence/review.json` and `fence/work.json` are unchanged, and no Claude session's argv, fence or settings changes.
criteria.evidence: git status shows no change under fence/ and no change to driver or Claude argv code; only docs/guide/commands.md, internal/cli/fence.go, internal/fence/judge.go and judge_test.go changed.
